answer_text:
Here are some fascinating and relatable weird habits that many people have — you might even recognize a few of your own!

---

### 🎨 1. Doodling During Phone Calls
There are a handful of people who doodle during phone calls to help keep themselves focused — and sometimes they don't even realize they're doing it until they're off the phone!

---

### 🗣️ 2. Talking to Inanimate Objects
Many people have the habit of talking to inanimate objects — like apologizing to a table after accidentally bumping into it, or yelling at a laptop when it freezes at the worst possible moment.

---

### 🚿 3. Rehearsing Arguments in the Shower
The shower seems to be the perfect place for people to rehearse arguments — the most brilliant comebacks for past conflicts always seem to surface while shampooing hair, long after the moment has passed.

---

### 🛑 4. Saying "Ow" Before Getting Hurt
Some people will say "Ow" when they bang something with another object, even though it didn't actually touch or hurt them. Even more amusingly, some say "Ow" way before something even hits them!

---

### 🗑️ 5. Folding Trash Neatly
Some people fold their trash — any pieces of paper, foil, chip bags, candy wrappers, paper towels, and gum wrappers — folding anything they can into a neat square before throwing it away.

---

### 🐕 6. Telling Objects to "Stay"
Some people, every time they set down a breakable object or something they don't want to misplace, point at it and tell it to "stay" out loud — like you would to a dog. One person never thought it was weird until someone saw them do it and asked if they were afraid the object would walk off.

---

### 🥤 7. Tapping a Can Before Opening It
Some people tap the lid of a can three times before opening it when drinking a Coke or beer — not even realizing they're doing it until someone notices and asks about it. One person went with "it's for luck" to avoid having to explain themselves!

---

### 📱 8. Scrolling Through Their Own Social Media
Some people scroll through their own Instagram or Facebook profiles as if they were their biggest fan — casually going through their posts, checking the number of likes, and feeling like a celebrity reading the comments.

---

### 🥦 9. Eating Foods Separately
Some people eat all the items on their plate separately — for example, eating all the chicken first, then all the broccoli. Many don't realize it's considered odd until someone else points it out!

---

### 🍽️ 10. Eating Unusual Snacks
On the more extreme end, some people have a habit of eating non-food items like dirt or chalk, a condition known as **pica**.

---

### 🌙 11. Midnight Cringe Sessions
Some people find that when they're wide awake at midnight, their brain decides it's the perfect time to remind them of every embarrassing thing they've ever done — suddenly cringing over something from five years ago!

---

As you can see, as humans, we're all odd in our own ways, but some of these tendencies are more common than you might think. So if you recognize yourself in any of these, you're definitely not alone! 😄
